messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident AUTH-SIGNING-OUTAGE triggered (sev2) — PagerDuty incident 23671
pagerduty: Escalation: Page sent to primary on-call @emily (60s unanswered) :rotating_light:
emily: ack — I'm on it. Looking at auth-signer logs now.
sanjay: seeing 500s hitting /v1/auth/validate in us-west-2 — spike started ~03:11 UTC. Error shows "invalid signature" for tokens issued 03:09–03:12.
emily: confirmed. Metrics: auth-validate failures ~9.4% of requests, burst to 120/s. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/auth-validate
maria: CS note — multiple customer-reported login failures, CS routing high priority tickets to oncall.
emily: initial hypothesis: key rotation race — auth-signer returned previous key after partial rollback; tokens issued have kid X while JWKS served kid Y.
sanjay: seeing in signer logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:09:58Z INFO Signing key rotated to kid=abc123
2026-03-15T03:10:12Z WARN Deploy rollback started for auth-signer
2026-03-15T03:10:18Z INFO Signing key set to kid=old_abc
```
emily: that would explain token mismatch. JWKS cache on validators still has new kid; validators rejecting tokens signed by old key.
cs-rep: any ETA to restore login flows? Customers impacted: data-sync services, SSO (Okta) flows for a handful of enterprise customers.
ryan: can we hotfix validators to accept both kids temporarily? Might be easier than forcing signer rollback.
emily: plan A: pin auth-signer to the new key (re-deploy correct version) — Plan B: update validators to accept fallback keys from KMS/JWKS (short term). Starting Plan A now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by @emily: deploy auth-signer v2.11.3 -> us-west-2 (canary 10%)
emily: canary shows reduced error rate in canary instances (to <0.5%) — rolling to 50%.
sanjay: switching traffic to canary reduces failures. Rolling to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Deploy successful: auth-signer v2.11.3 -> us-west-2 (100%)
emily: post-deploy: auth-validate errors back to baseline ~0.2%. JWKS endpoints show stable kid=abc123 across all instances.
cs-rep: informing affected customers: pinged top 3 impacted accounts, offering incident notes and timeline.
ryan: doing short runbook: force-refresh JWKS cache on validator fleet: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-validator --namespace=production` — executed.
emily: confirmed validators reloaded and picked up jwks. Monitoring looks good.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to sev3 — customer impact mitigated.
emily: handoff to @ryan for postmortem and action items. Leaving notes in incident ticket #23671. @maria please coordinate comms / public status update.
ryan: ack — taking over. Will open postmortem, include RCA: partial rollback caused key flip; suggestions: atomic key-switching in deploys, validation tolerance during rollout, add healthcheck verifying jwks/signer consistency. Assigning action items to infra and deploy teams.
emily: thanks all. Night folks. :thumbsup:
